risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (317), strong dollar pressures multinationals, and earnings event in 39 days compounds uncertainty.

debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought technicals (RSI-9 at 72.61, Stoch-K at 85.11), compressed Bollinger Bands, no fresh crossover signals, zero fundamental conviction, earnings risk in 39 days, and severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis, strong dollar) create multiple layers of downside risk with limited upside catalysts.
